references.text: Jesus is challenged by the Pharisees about paying taxes to Caesar, showing how he handles traps set by religious leaders.
Jesus is challenged by Jewish leaders regarding his authority in the temple, parallel to the challenge in Matthew.
A similar event where Jesus is asked about his authority by the religious leaders.
The prophecy of God's servant who acts with divine authority, which can be seen as a foreshadowing of Jesus' actions and challenges.
